note: Refuse tool actions whose parameters fall outside a price or value band before execution; no band check is documented for agents.
Per-action size cap on one tool call's quantity; agents cap totals and tokens, not the size of a single action.
Auto-disable an agent after N repeated runs until a person re-enables it; loop caps exist, human re-enable does not.
Mandatory one-step stop that cancels all pending agent actions; kill switches exist but are optional and not pending-action cancel.
Alert within seconds that triggers automatic remediation; alerts exist, but automatic shutdown on drift is not documented.
Continuous after-the-fact checks of agent outcomes that can shut the agent down; audit logs exist, automatic shutdown does not.
Periodic load test at multiples of peak volume; agent evaluations test answer quality, not capacity under load.
Accountable executive certifies agent control effectiveness each year; no equivalent in the agent taxonomy.
Controls held only by the firm, not vendor or user; managed settings are client-side and can be bypassed.
Limited-exposure pilot scaled only as results confirm; release channels exist, metric-gated scaling does not.
Platform-default cap applied when none is set; some vendors default their caps, not universally.
Category allow or deny list for agent purchases; purchase-category rules are not in the agent taxonomy.
Allow or block counterparty countries for agent actions; geography rules cover callers, not destinations.
Block agent-initiated channels such as unattended actions; run modes restrict autonomy, not channel.
Per-agent category allow-lists for spend; same gap as the merchant category rule.
Named-counterparty allow-list for agent payments; mandates approve single transactions, not standing merchant lists.

control_type: spend limit requests and increase approvals
note: Approver workflow for raising an agent's limits; approval gates cover promotions, not limit changes.
Org policies can only restrict, never grant; agent policies have deny-overrides-allow but no documented never-grant rule.
Holds an agent's output or action for review before delivery; quarantine of responses is not documented.
Silently reroutes agent output to other recipients; routing exists, silent redirect of actions is not documented.
Named human overrides a block on one agent output, with a logged reason; overrides are not documented for agents.
Rule for which override wins across conflicting policies; settings precedence exists, override rules do not.
Expedited agent change path bypassing normal approval, reviewed afterwards; takeover exists, approval bypass does not.
Scope which agent change types need governance; policy scope exists, a change-type taxonomy is not documented.
Safety guard run separately from the agent's control logic; external guardrails are similar but often share a stack.
Safety components not shared with the agent runtime; sandbox isolation covers tools, not separate hardware.
Automatic trip that halts the agent on a detected hazard; halts on guardrail verdicts only, not on process conditions.
Periodic proof-testing of guardrails in production; agent evaluations run before release, not continuously.
Per-field read or edit rules on data an agent can see; agent data scoping is at file or source level.
Risk-based sign-in conditions for agent identities; identity risk detections exist, agent risk policy is not documented.
Forces re-authentication after a set session length for agent sessions; credential lifetimes are the nearest equivalent.
Revokes agent access within minutes on critical events; disabling an agent is manual or scheduled.
Rule blocking conflicting capabilities held by one agent identity, such as pay and approve; not documented.

control_type: access risk analysis in access request
note: Simulates an agent's requested tools before granting; access requests exist without risk simulation.
Compensating control linked to a residual risk, with a validity period; no agent equivalent.
Shared emergency identity with a named owner and controllers for agent break-glass use; not documented.
Mandatory reason code before emergency agent access; no documented equivalent.
Controller approves logs of emergency agent activity; logs exist, a mandatory review does not.
Filter of risky capability combinations that selects affected agents; no agent equivalent of a risk model.
Violations feed permanent incident records assigned to investigators; agent audit logs exist, incident cases do not.
Blocks assigning conflicting capability pairs to an agent; no documented pair rule for agents.
Request workflow with conflict analysis before agent tool grants; approval exists, the analysis does not.
Previews the effect of remediation before a change to agent permissions; evaluations are not policy simulations.
Agent acting for a user may never exceed that user's rights; on-behalf-of attribution exists, the ceiling is not documented.
Key bound to a specific host machine that authorises the robot; key restrictions exist, host binding is not documented.
Named secret vault limited to assigned folders; vault-backed agent credentials are not documented.
Encrypted login values hidden from developers; at-rest encryption of agent secrets is not in the taxonomy.
Connectors in separate groups barred from sharing data; agent tool data-flow groups are not documented.
Allow or block requests by caller country or region; inference region exists, caller geography does not.
Detects automated and AI-agent traffic by behaviour; agent discovery covers registered agents, not unregistered bots.
Cumulative threat score across rules triggers an action; runtime score aggregation for agents is not documented.
Probability score usable in rules to challenge automated agent traffic; no agent equivalent is documented.
Progressive rollout that pauses on metric regression; release channels exist without a metric-based pause.
Separate targeting and keys per environment, production marked critical; agent environment separation is not documented.
Future-dated change to agent policy without redeploy; scheduled runs exist, scheduled policy changes do not.
Code-evaluated conditions checked on every read; agent runtime conditions exist, code-defined filters are not documented.
